title: Thinking Pattern
description: Schema for thinking pattern templates. Each pattern defines a reusable reasoning structure. (Originally authored for PolarPilot, retired 2026-08-11; the schema remains valid for any Agent form.)

name.description: Human-readable name for this thinking pattern

tags.description: Tags used for matching this pattern to tasks

description.description: When to use this pattern and what it achieves

applicable_types.description: Target types this pattern applies to (e.g. 'code_review', 'architecture', 'debugging')

version.description: Optional version identifier for this pattern
